protocol.selection: one original Dev-main best checkpoint per learner seed, equal-load daily on-time mean then mean daily reward, earliest exact tie; no per-load checkpoint or Test seed selection

statistics.primary: equal-load mean daily on_time_rate, averaged over five learners
statistics.bootstrap: paired crossed learner-ID and demand-day-ID product bootstrap; same day draws across all loads and methods, common learner-ID pairing across methods; baselines fixed learner dimension 1
statistics.multiplicity: pointwise 95% intervals, no familywise adjustment; all primary comparisons predeclared
statistics.limitations: only five learner repetitions; fixed map; not 1500 independent training runs

protocol.random_protocol: uniform legal actions, per-day isolated SeedSequence([0,day,load_index,0])
protocol.evaluation: canonical original network forward and deterministic masked categorical argmax; optional inference optimization not used for scientific Test
protocol.post_test_policy: No further model/selection/hyperparameter changes. Any later tuning is new exploration and this Test is consumed.

mlp.method: paired crossed learner-ID/day-ID nonparametric product bootstrap; equal load weight
mlp.limitations: five training repetitions limit bootstrap reliability; fixed map; no 1500-independent-episode assumption
